MEET OUR DOCTORS

Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort. We're the trusted go-to dentist in Winston Salem for compassionate care.

Grace Aileru, DDS
MORE+
Grace Aileru, DDS
Dr. Grace Aileru is a native of Hempstead, NY, and a proud graduate of South Carolina State College. She earned her Doctor of Dental Surgery degree from the University of North Carolina School of Dentistry in Chapel Hill in 1993 and went on to complete her residency with the U.S. Army, where she served for four years. A devoted mother of two, she now resides in Clemmons. As a born-again Christian, she finds joy and purpose in her faith and is excited about knowing Jesus while providing compassionate dental care to her patients.
VIEW PROFILE
Sam Byrd, DDS
MORE+
Sam Byrd, DDS
Dr. Byrd is a native of Sanford, North Carolina, and a proud graduate of N.C. State University, where he earned his B.S. in Biological Sciences. He went on to receive his D.D.S. from the University of North Carolina School of Dentistry. Dedicated to lifelong learning, he is a member of the American Dental Association, the Academy of General Dentistry, the North Carolina Dental Society, and the Forsyth County Dental Society. He has earned the Fellowship Award from the Academy of General Dentistry and is currently pursuing the Mastership Award.
VIEW PROFILE
Herb Johnson, DDS
MORE+
Herb Johnson, DDS
Dr. Herb Johnson is a proud graduate of the University of North Carolina School of Dentistry in Chapel Hill. Originally from Elkin, North Carolina, he spent nine years in Chapel Hill before moving to the area. A Fellow of the Academy of General Dentistry, Dr. Johnson is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive care to his patients.
VIEW PROFILE
Elizabeth Dixon, DDS
MORE+
Elizabeth Dixon, DDS
Dr. Elizabeth Dixon earned both her B.S. degree and Doctor of Dental Surgery from McGill University in Montreal, Quebec, where she also completed her General Practice Residency. She practiced in a large dental office in Montreal for 13 years before relocating to Winston-Salem, North Carolina, in 2003.
VIEW PROFILE
Catherine Watkins, DDS
MORE+
Catherine Watkins, DDS
Dr. Catherine Watkins is a Diplomate of the American Board of Special Care Dentistry with over 20 years of experience in geriatric dentistry. She earned her DDS from UNC Chapel Hill, completed residency training in Special Patient Care in Rochester, NY, and holds a Master’s in Geriatric Dentistry and a Ph.D. in Oral Epidemiology. A former professor at the University of Iowa, she later established the Special Needs Dental Program at Wake Forest Baptist Medical Center. Dr. Watkins is dedicated to improving oral health care for seniors and patients with special needs.
VIEW PROFILE
Matthew McCullough, DDS
MORE+
Matthew McCullough, DDS
Dr. Matthew McCullough was born in New Iberia, LA and grew up in Houston, TX. He attended US Military Academy at West Point and served 5 years as an active-duty Army officer. After being discharged from active duty, Dr. McCullough attended the University of Texas School of Dentistry at Houston, graduating in 2014. He has lived in Texas, Hawaii, Colorado, and has now permanently settled in North Carolina.
VIEW PROFILE
Preston Wilson, DMD
MORE+
Preston Wilson, DMD
Dr. Preston Wilson, originally from Ashe County, NC, earned his B.S. in Computer Science from Appalachian State University in 2019 before discovering his true calling in dentistry. He went on to receive his DMD from ECU School of Dental Medicine in 2023, followed by a yearlong AEGD residency in 2024, where he gained advanced training in root canals, oral surgery, implants, and restorative care.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Are emergency dental services available in Winston-Salem?

We make an effort to see all emergency patients same day or next day, but there may be instances where we’ll refer you to another of our convenient practices if schedules are tight so make sure you’re seen as soon as possible.

Can I get cosmetic dentistry in Winston-Salem?

Yes - cosmetic procedures and treatments ranging from tooth whitening to veneers to Invisalign® are all availalbe at our Winston-Salem location.

Do Winston-Salem dentists treat children and teens?

Yes - pediatric care is available. Bring your whole family and we’ll keep everyone’s smile bright for the next family photo.

How do I schedule an appointment with a Winston-Salem dentist?

Give us a call at (336) 331-3500 or book online and we’ll get you on the schedule as soon as possible.

What services do dentists in Winston-Salem provide?

A wide variety of services are available in our Winston-Salem location including general & pediatric dentistry, routine hygiene, emergency dentistry, cosmetic dentistry (including whitening) and dental implants.
